title: 3EN Automation Core - keep network autopilot and restore persistent project inbox
description: Preserve and start the existing Network Autopilot, then install and start the generic persistent 3EN Project Inbox so future projects are delivered through GitHub without routine user bootstrap commands.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent';$dir=$root+'/network-autopilot';New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir|Out-Null;$rev='5ed0975d6c57fa1ac0d1a5d25d6dc5f9a09f50af';$src='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3en4all/3en-command-runner/'+$rev+'/scripts/3en-network-autopilot-v1.ps1';$dst=$dir+'/3en-network-autopilot-v1.ps1';Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $src -OutFile $dst;$t=$null;$e=$null;[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($dst,[ref]$t,[ref]$e)|Out-Null;if(@($e).Count -gt 0){throw ('AUTOPILOT_SYNTAX_ERRORS='+@($e).Count)};$action=New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument ('-NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "'+$dst+'"');$trigger=New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn -User $env:USERNAME;$principal=New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId $env:USERNAME -LogonType Interactive -RunLevel Highest;$settings=New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -ExecutionTimeLimit ([TimeSpan]::Zero);Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Network Autopilot' -Action $action -Trigger $trigger -Principal $principal -Settings $settings -Force|Out-Null;Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Network Autopilot';$poller=$root+'/3en-project-inbox.ps1';$ts=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds();Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3en4all/3en-command-runner/main/automation/3en-project-inbox.ps1?ts='+$ts) -OutFile $poller;$pt=$null;$pe=$null;[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($poller,[ref]$pt,[ref]$pe)|Out-Null;if(@($pe).Count -gt 0){throw ('PROJECT_INBOX_SYNTAX_ERRORS='+@($pe).Count)};$runner=$root+'/3en-agent-runner-v4.0.3.ps1';if(-not(Test-Path $runner)){throw 'RUNNER403_MISSING'};$startupDir=Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs/Startup';New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $startupDir|Out-Null;$cmd=Join-Path $startupDir '3EN-Project-Inbox.cmd';$line='@echo off'+[Environment]::NewLine+'start "3EN Project Inbox" /min powershell.exe -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "'+$poller+'"';Set-Content -LiteralPath $cmd -Value $line -Encoding ASCII;$existing=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='powershell.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -match '3en-project-inbox\.ps1'};if(-not $existing){Start-Process powershell.exe -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-WindowStyle','Hidden','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$poller) -WorkingDirectory $root|Out-Null};Write-Host 'AUTOMATION_CORE_INSTALLED_AND_STARTED'
